name: Local IDM head / decoder adaptation factorial
seed_meaning: minibatch-stream replicate, identical pretrained H0/D0 for every seed
optimizer: AdamW; weight decay .01 for matrices, zero for bias/norm vectors
objective: mean feature MSE + drift_beta * mean(0.5 sum((mu-mu0)^2/exp(logvar0))) for H/HD; MSE only D/K
variance: reference variance fixed, original N(0,I) KL diagnostic only
primary_scope_gate: mean train drift <=1 nat and all gradients finite; otherwise no adoption even if MSE improves
constant: single train-only mean of starting mu
evaluation: fixed400 all arms; reused dev64/observed96 and train; no checkpoint selection
secondary_evaluation: fixed same-current future swaps and independent existing interaction effect probe; neither is action identity or conditional MI
resource_schedule: maximum4 fits with4threads each plus2threads independent review; no GPU
training_status: not started; implementation tests and source-binding preflight required first
decision: Require visual improvement over F and isolate H/D/HD effect; D versus K tests transition-specific utility. Known optimization/trust-region controls, no novelty claim.
